native_mechanisms: A chained line of prisoners grinds a blank pillar mark by mark: nothing of the mark is kept, only the stroke's angle, which carries forward from every prior stroke (and the top stage carries backward into the line).
A flood that never recedes until all marks have passed bends eight wires anchored in the riverbed, each by the angle ground into the pillar on that pass; nothing is read back out mid-flood.
The token is the single fixed silhouette the wires throw against the sun after the flood drains and the shapes stop shivering — one projection (lean / stand / cross), read once and kept alone.
core_technique: Multiplication-free LFSR/CRC-style state grinding (hardware _mm_crc32_u64, else a bidirectional xorshift round) folding 64-bit words into eight parallel anchored 32-bit accumulators, followed by a cross-lane carry chain and a wide-multiply + murmur3-style avalanche finalizer.
